description: Object /maintenance (API.md §22, step 5o part B5): the workspace's maintenance. execute_deletion is task-streamed, in a model segment of the caller's environment, its deletion the in-process editor's (loomworks.model_commands deletion_request / deletion_run).

execute_deletion.description: Remove build state and what it belongs to (API.md §22), with the outcomes of reset (§8.5) and its confirmation (§8.6). The deletion is planned after resolution and before any lock: with a plan the new plan differs from it is refused (the build directories to delete changed since they were listed, exit 1), before the empty check; with nothing to delete refused (nothing to delete, exit 0, stream out); without yes confirm (lines, plan) with nothing locked or changed; with yes it is accepted (without plan the task prints the listing first). An accepted deletion takes the workspace operation lock, then the build-directory lock of every directory of the plan (exclusive, canonical order; a held one ends the task naming the holder, nothing removed), plans again under the locks (a changed plan ends the task with the same refusal) and removes as spec §4.6-§4.7 specify. A stray_dir outside the workspace (path outside workspace: <path>), not in the current stray set (not a stray build directory: <path>) or holding a live build directory (directory holds a live build dir: <path>) is refused. A project whose build directories are not all removed is kept and the task ends refused. A cancel stops between directories (delete stopped: <reason>). The task's writes' changed precede done. A stale id is refused (a stale reference).

target.description: What to delete: exactly one of profile, unit, build_dir, stray_dir, orphans, project.

profile.description: The profile and the build directories only it uses; the profile is deactivated first when active.

unit.description: A configuration unit (its id, as view.Workspace/1 lists it): its build directory and cached state.

build_dir.description: An orphaned build directory: its id in view.Workspace/1 orphaned.configurations.

stray_dir.description: A stray build directory, the path as view.Workspace/1 lists it.

orphans.description: Every orphaned and stray build directory.

project.description: The project's build state, then its declaration, then its profiles' toolchain downgrade, in that order in the one task.

plan.description: The token of the confirm result the user accepted; a changed plan is refused.
